name: Shadow copy deletion
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 8222 or (EventID == 4688 and ProcessName endswith '\\vssadmin.exe' and CommandLine has 'delete')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=8222 OR (EventCode=4688 AND Image=*\\vssadmin.exe AND CommandLine=*delete*)
tuning: Alert immediately — no legitimate business reason to delete shadow copies without change ticket.

name: Certutil download of executable
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == 'certutil.exe' and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @'(-urlcache|-verifyctl|-decodehex)' and (ProcessCommandLine contains '.exe' or ProcessCommandLine contains '.dll' or ProcessCommandLine contains '.ps1')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=ProcessRollup2 OR sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessCreation Image=*\\certutil.exe (CommandLine=*-urlcache* OR CommandLine=*-verifyctl*)
tuning: Exclude IT-approved script update jobs; verify destination path under TEMP/Public before alerting.
apt: Ryuk, pre-ransom activity, many commodity loaders

name: Kerberoasting — RC4 service ticket requests
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4769 | where TicketEncryptionType == '0x17' | where ServiceName !endswith '$' | summarize count() by SubjectUserName, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m) | where count_ >= 3
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4769 TicketEncryptionType=0x17 NOT ServiceName=*$ | stats count by User, src_ip, _time | where count >= 3
tuning: Baseline service accounts; exclude known SPNs requested by legitimate apps (MSSQL, Exchange); enable AES after reviewing.

name: DCSync — directory replication request
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4662 | where ObjectServer == 'DS' | where OperationType == 'Control Access' | where (ObjectName startswith 'Replicating Directory Changes' or ObjectName startswith 'Replicating Directory Changes All') | where Account !in ('MSOL_*')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4662 ObjectServer=DS (ObjectName="Replicating Directory Changes*") NOT User=MSOL_*
tuning: If Change Notification All fires broadly, use ldap:1138/1139 access events; whitelist legitimate sync tools.
apt: Mimikatz users: Conti, APT28, FIN7, Volt Typhoon

name: Pass-the-Hash NTLM logon
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 3 | where AccountName != '$' | join kind=leftouter (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 8004) on Account
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4624 LogonType=3 NOT User=*$ | join User [search index=windows EventCode=8004]
tuning: Alert when NTLM logon source differs from account's usual host; enable Negotiate/NTLM auditing on DCs.

name: Admin group member added (DCSync/ACL attack precursor)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4728, 4729, 4732, 4733, 4756, 4757) | where TargetAccount in ('Domain Admins', 'Administrators', 'Enterprise Admins', 'Schema Admins', 'Account Operators')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode IN (4728,4732,4756) TargetAccount IN ("Domain Admins","Administrators","Enterprise Admins")
tuning: Immediately suspicious unless driven by password manager/ITSM workflow.

name: Scheduled task creation pointing to writable path
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4698 | where TaskContent contains '\\Users\\' or TaskContent contains 'Temp' or TaskContent contains 'AppData' or TaskContent contains 'Base64'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4698 (TaskContent=*Users* OR TaskContent=*Temp* OR TaskContent=*AppData*)
tuning: Baseline legit product tasks (Adobe, Teams update); focus on tasks with /script or powershell -enc.
apt: Semi-common persistence for APT29, Wizard Spider

name: Run key / startup folder persistence
kql: DeviceRegistryEvents | where ActionType == 'RegistryValueSet' | where RegistryKey has_any ('CurrentVersion\\Run', 'CurrentVersion\\RunOnce') | where RegistryValueData contains '.exe' | where not(RegistryValueData contains '\\Program Files' or RegistryValueData contains '\\Windows\\')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:Registry EventCode=13 TargetObject=*CurrentVersion\\Run* OR TargetObject=*RunOnce*
tuning: Whitelist known AV/agent entries (Defender, CrowdStrike, Sentinel).
apt: Classic; used by APT32, Turla, many

name: WMI event subscription creation
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5861 | where ProviderName contains 'EventFilter' or ProviderName contains 'EventConsumer' or ProviderName contains 'Binding'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operational EventCode=5861
tuning: Baseline out of box — any new permanent subscription by non-admin is suspicious.

name: Service installed from unusual path
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 7045 | where ServiceFileName !startswith 'C:\\Windows\\' and ServiceFileName !startswith 'C:\\Program Files' and ServiceFileName !startswith 'C:\\Program Files (x86)'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:System EventCode=7045 NOT ImagePath=*\\Windows\\* NOT ImagePath=*\\Program Files*
tuning: Exclude vendor agents installed into custom paths; alert is cheap at this volume.

name: LSASS access from non-system process
kql: DeviceEvents | where ActionType == 'OpenProcessApiCall' or ActionType == 'ProcessAccess' | where TargetFileName contains 'lsass.exe' | where InitiatingProcessFileName != 'lsass.exe' | where ProcessAccessRightFlags has 'VM_READ' or GrantedAccess != '0x1000'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessAccess EventCode=10 TargetImage=*\\lsass.exe NOT SourceImage=*sysmon* NOT SourceImage=*lsass*
tuning: Whitelist AV scanners running OpenProcess on lsass (defender, edr dlls).

name: SAM/SYSTEM hive copy attempt
kql: DeviceFileEvents | where FileName in ('sam', 'system', 'security') | where FolderPath contains '\\Windows\\System32\\config' | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains 'reg save' or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains 'vssadmin'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:FileCreation EventCode=11 TargetFilename=*\\config\\SAM OR TargetFilename=*\\config\\SYSTEM
tuning: config\SAM reads via reg.exe save outside backup windows = dump attempt.
apt: APTs extracting local hashes for PTH

name: Disabled security service (Defender stop)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 7036 | where AccountName contains 'WinDefend' or AccountName contains 'wscsvc' | where EventType == 'stopped'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:System EventCode=7036 (Message=*Windows Defender* OR Message=*Security Center*) (Message=*stopped*)
tuning: No legit reason to stop Defender except maintenance — pair with GPO change audit.

name: Registry exclusion added to Defender
kql: DeviceRegistryEvents | where RegistryKey has ('Exclusions\\Path' or 'Exclusions\\Process' or 'Exclusions\\Extension') | where RegistryValueName != ''
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:Registry EventCode=12 TargetObject=*Exclusions*
tuning: Malware disables AV via exclusion of its own dir — alert every exclusion add.

name: Unusual PowerShell -enc execution
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == 'powershell.exe' or FileName == 'pwsh.exe' | where ProcessCommandLine contains '-enc' or ProcessCommandLine contains '-encodedcommand' | where ProcessCommandLine !contains 'Invoke-WebRequest'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=ProcessRollup2 Image=*\\powershell.exe (CommandLine=*-enc* OR CommandLine=*-encodedcommand*)
tuning: Alert; include flag for -w hidden and -nop combos for higher severity.

name: AMSI bypass / Reflection.Assembly Load
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName in ('powershell.exe','pwsh.exe') | where ProcessCommandLine contains 'Reflection.Assembly' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'Microsoft.Win32.UnsafeNativeMethods' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'FreeLibrary'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational EventCode=4104 ScriptBlockText=*Reflection.Assembly* OR ScriptBlockText=*AMSI*
tuning: Script block logging must be enabled (4104); any match is near-certain malice.

name: Suspicious parent-child: Office spawning shell
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName in ('powershell.exe','cmd.exe','wscript.exe','mshta.exe','rundll32.exe','cscript.exe') | where InitiatingProcessFileName in ('winword.exe','excel.exe','powerpnt.exe','outlook.exe')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessCreation EventCode=1 ParentImage=*\\WINWORD.EXE OR ParentImage=*\\EXCEL.EXE OR ParentImage=*\\OUTLOOK.EXE
tuning: Macros emitting shells are ~always malicious; check for DDE/automation legit uses.
apt: Phishing initial access — APT28, APT29, ALL

name: Mshta execution
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == 'mshta.exe' | where ProcessCommandLine contains 'http' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'javascript:'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=ProcessRollup2 Image=*\\mshta.exe
tuning: mshta + URL/js = weaponized; rare in enterprise.

name: Rundll32 with remote URL (davclnt/url.dll)
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == 'rundll32.exe' | where ProcessCommandLine contains 'url.dll,FileProtocolHandler' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'javascript:' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'http'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=ProcessRollup2 Image=*\\rundll32.exe CommandLine=*javascript:* OR CommandLine=*FileProtocolHandler*
tuning: URL.dll/FileProtocolHandler fetches remote payloads.

name: WMI process launch (winmgmt spawn)
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName == 'wmiprvse.exe' | where FileName != 'svchost.exe' and FileName != 'conhost.exe'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessCreation EventCode=1 ParentImage=*\\wmiprvse.exe NOT Image=*\\svchost.exe
tuning: Benign WMI consumer launches happen; focus on child = powershell/cmd of remote origin (source port > 1024).

name: Beaconing — fixed-interval outbound connections
kql: DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemotePort != 443 or Direction == 'Outbound' | summarize start=min(Timestamp), end=max(Timestamp), total=count(), distinct=make_set(RemoteUrl) by InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP | extend span = datetime_diff('second', end, start) | where total >= 10 | extend rate = total / max(span / 3600.0, 1) | where rate >= 0.5 and rate <= 30
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational EventCode=3 Direction=Out | stats count by Image, DestIp, _time | where count > 10
tuning: Baseline legit cloud telemetry; look for count spikes from single process at regular delta (jitter-aware)

name: DNS query to DGA-like domain
kql: DeviceNetworkEvents | where ActionType == 'DnsQuery' | where RemoteUrl matches regex @'^[a-z0-9]{12,}\.(top|xyz|ru|info|site)$'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:Network EventCode=22 QueryName=* regex=^[a-z0-9]{12,}\.
tuning: High-entropy TLDs per-domain-daily; aggregate by host for confirmation.

name: PowerShell download cradle
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName in ('powershell.exe','pwsh.exe') | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ('DownloadString','DownloadFile','Invoke-WebRequest','IWR ','Net.WebClient')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational EventCode=4104 ScriptBlockText=*DownloadString* OR ScriptBlockText=*IEX*
tuning: Whitelist HTTPS-only admin scripts from known update endpoints; flag HTTP.

name: SMB ADMIN$ access from workstation
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5140 | where ShareName == 'ADMIN$' | where AccountName !endswith '$' | where IpAddress !startswith '10.10.'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=5140 ShareName=ADMIN$ NOT User=*$
tuning: Baseline admin tooling; alert when workstation→server ADMIN$ without PSExec allowlist.

name: RDP logon from unusual source
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 10 | where IpAddress != '127.0.0.1' | project TimeGenerated, Account, IpAddress, Computer, WorkstationName
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4624 LogonType=10 NOT src_ip=127.0.0.1
tuning: Compare source vs target computer naming heuristic; temporal outliers by account.

name: PsExec/SMBExec execution
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5140 and ShareName == 'ADMIN$' and RelativeTargetName contains 'PSEXESVC' | or (DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == 'psexec.exe')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=5140 ShareName=ADMIN$ RelativeTargetName=*PSEXESVC OR index=windows Image=*\\psexec.exe
tuning: org standard = allowlist sysadmin hosts; unknown psexec = immediate investigation.

name: Copying files to ADMIN$ share (staging)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5145 | where RelativeTargetName matches regex @'ADMIN\$.*\.(exe|dll|bat|ps1|zip)$'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=5145 RelativeTargetName=ADMIN$* (*.exe OR *.dll OR *.bat OR *.ps1 OR *.zip)
tuning: Immediate alert.

name: Golden ticket (TGT w/ krbtgt anomalies)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4768 | where TicketEncryptionType == '0x17' | where AccountName == 'krbtgt' | where IpAddress !in (allowed KC IPs)
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4768 (User=krbtgt OR TicketEncryptionType=0x17)
tuning: RC4 TGT requests for krbtgt always flag 0x17; detect via encryption downgrade.

name: New local admin added on servers
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4732 | where TargetAccount == 'Administrators' | where Computer contains 'srv'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4732 TargetAccount=Administrators host=*srv*
tuning: Compare vs ITSM request list; immediate for user accounts.

name: Brute force — lockout storm
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4740 | summarize count() by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | where count_ >= 5
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4740 | stats count by host, _time | where count > 5
tuning: Lockout storms across accounts = spray; single-account = targeted.

name: Password spray — many 4625 for one account
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4625 | where LogonType in (3, 10) | summarize count() by Account, IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | where count_ >= 10
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4625 | stats count by User, src_ip | where count > 10
tuning: Baseline account-specific; spray uses slow cadence — use 24h windows too.

name: Unusual logon out of hours (admin)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where Account in (AdminAccounts) | where hour_of_day(TimeGenerated) between (22 .. 5) | where LogonType in (3, 10, 8)
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4624 User IN (admins) NOT wday, _time | where _time >= relative_now(7d) | eval h=strftime(_time,"%H") | where h>=22 OR h<=5
tuning: Needs admin account group baseline; exclude on-call rotations.

name: Email forwarding rule created (BEC)
kql: EmailEvents | join kind=inner (AuditLogs | where Operation == 'Set-Mailbox' | where modification != '') on SenderFromAddress
spl: index=o365 sourcetype=o365:management:activity Operation=Set-Mailbox AND (Parameters{}.Name=ForwardSmtpAddress OR Parameters{}.Name=ForwardingSmtpAddress)
tuning: Alert on any new forwarding rule to external domain by executive accounts.

name: OAuth app consent grant to external tenant
kql: AuditLogs | where Operation == 'Consent to application' | where result != 'success' or contains ThreatIntelligence
spl: index=o365 sourcetype=o365:management:activity Operation="Consent to application"
tuning: CT policies: block high-risk app consent; monitor OAuth2PermissionGrant adds.

name: AAD sign-in from risky IP + legacy auth
kql: SigninLogs | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn == 'high' | where AuthenticationRequirement contains 'legacy' | where AppDisplayName != 'Microsoft Teams'
spl: index=o365 sourcetype=o365:management:activity (Operation=UserLoginFailed OR Operation=UserLoginSucceeded) AuthenticationRequirement=legacy clientIp=*
tuning: Pair with confirmed phishing campaigns.

name: MFA fatigue — repeated MFA prompts
kql: SigninLogs | where ResultType != '0' | summarize failures=count() by UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m) | where failures >= 5
spl: index=o365 sourcetype=o365:management:activity Operation=UserLoginFailed | stats count by user | where count > 5
tuning: Multiple 'approve' demands = fatigue; require number matching / conditional access.

name: CloudTrail: DeleteTrail / StopLogging
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName in ('DeleteTrail','StopLogging','UpdateTrail') | where UserIdentity.arn !in (allowedSecOps)
spl: index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail EventName=DeleteTrail OR EventName=StopLogging
tuning: Enable S3 object lock + trail immutability; alert immediately.

name: CloudTrail: console login without MFA
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'ConsoleLogin' | where responseElements.ConsoleLogin == 'Failure' or (responseElements.AdditionalDetails.MFAUsed != 'Yes')
spl: index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail EventName=ConsoleLogin responseElements.AdditionalDetails.MFAUsed=No
tuning: Require MFA; alert No MFA logins from non-bootstrap IAM users.

name: IAM policy modification / privilege escalation
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName has_any ('AttachUserPolicy','AttachRolePolicy','CreatePolicyVersion','PutUserPolicy','AddUserToGroup','CreateAccessKey')
spl: index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail EventName IN (AttachUserPolicy, CreateAccessKey, AddUserToGroup, CreatePolicyVersion)
tuning: Alert ALL; cross-check with change tickets.

name: S3 bucket policy public exposure
kql: AWSCloudTrail | where EventName == 'PutBucketPolicy' | where requestParameters.bucketPolicy.Policy contains '"Effect":"Allow"' and requestParameters.bucketPolicy.Policy contains '"Principal":"*"'
spl: index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail EventName=PutBucketPolicy (Policy=*Principal\":*"*"*)
tuning: Any public-principal bucket policy = alert.

name: Azure: new guest user added
kql: AuditLogs | where Operation == 'Add guest user' | where TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties contains 'invitedUser'
spl: index=o365 sourcetype=azure:audit Operation="Add guest user"
tuning: Baseline invite workflow; guest + admin role = critical.

name: GCP: service account key creation
kql: GCPAuditLogs | where operation.method == 'CreateServiceAccountKey' | where actor.email !in (allowed)
spl: index=gcp sourcetype=gcp:audit resource.type=service_account method=CreateServiceAccountKey
tuning: Keys are long-lived creds — alert + respond.

name: Linux: SSH key added to authorized_keys
kql: FileCreateTelemetryEvents | where FilePath endswith 'authorized_keys' | where FileName != 'authorized_keys' or InitiatingProcessFileName != 'sshd'
spl: index=linux sourcetype=linux:audit auditd.type=SYSCALL key=ssh|authorized_keys
tuning: authorized_keys writes by non-admin or over network = backdoor.

name: Linux: bashrc/profile modification
kql: FileCreateTelemetryEvents | where FilePath has_any ('.bashrc','.bash_profile','.profile','.zshrc') | where InitiatingProcessFileName != 'bash'
spl: index=linux sourcetype=linux:audit auditd.type=PATH name=*.bashrc OR name=*.profile
tuning: Baseline admin touch events.

name: SSH login from new IP for established account
kql: LinuxLogs | where ProcessName == 'sshd' | where Message contains 'Accepted password' | where IpAddress !in (knownAdminIPs)
spl: index=linux sourcetype=linux:syslog sshd.*Accepted* | lookup admin_ips.csv IP
tuning: First-seen IP per account over 30d window.

name: TGT request for sensitive SPN (admin SPN hunting)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4769 | where ServiceName has_any ('MSSQLSvc','HTTP/','exchangeAB') | where AccountName !endswith '$'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4769 (ServiceName=MSSQLSvc* OR ServiceName=HTTP/*)
tuning: SPN tgt hunting reveals kerberoastable service accounts.

name: Suspicious Account.Name contains 'svc' but not service
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where Account endswith 'svc' or Account startswith 'svc_' | where LogonType == 3 | where Account !in (knownSvcAccounts)
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4624 User=*svc* LogonType=3
tuning: Unknown svc accounts with network logon → credential reuse.

name: AS-REP roasting (Kerberos pre-auth disabled)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4768 | where PreAuthenticationType == 0 | where AccountName !in (legacyAllowed)
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4768 PreAuthType=0 OR PreAuthenticationType=0
tuning: Any 4768 with PreAuthenticationType=0 = roastable account; disable pre-auth for anomalies.

name: Obfuscated certutil decode to PE
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName == 'certutil.exe' | where ProcessCommandLine contains '-decode' | where ProcessCommandLine contains '.exe' or ProcessCommandLine contains '.dll'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessCreation Image=*\\certutil.exe CommandLine=*-decode* (*.exe OR *.dll)
tuning: decode of exe = payload restore

name: File copy to hidden share / exfil staging
kql: DeviceFileEvents | where FileName has_any ('.zip','.7z','.rar') | where FolderPath contains '\\Users\\' | where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ('7z.exe','rar.exe','winrar.exe','tar.exe') | summarize count() by InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | where count_ >= 5
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:FileCreation EventCode=11 Image=*\\7z.exe OR Image=*\\rar.exe
tuning: rar/7z not in RMM tooling catalog + archive creation = staging

name: HTTP POST to external host with large payload
kql: DeviceNetworkEvents | where Direction == 'Outbound' | where RemoteUrl startswith 'http://' | where InitiatingProcessFileName in ('powershell.exe','rundll32.exe','curl.exe','bitsadmin.exe')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:Network EventCode=3 Direction=Out Image=*\\powershell.exe OR Image=*\\rundll32.exe
tuning: Proxy logs + byte counts needed for true volume signal

name: DLL sideload from writable location
kql: DeviceImageLoadEvents | where FileName endswith '.dll' | where FolderPath contains 'Users\\' or FolderPath contains 'Temp' | where InitiatingProcessFileName == 'svchost.exe' and FolderPath not contains 'System32'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ImageLoad EventCode=7 ImageLoaded=*\\Users\\* Image=*
tuning: DLLs from user-writable dirs into system binaries = sideload.

name: New process spawned from WebRoot/Debug dirs on IIS
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName == 'w3wp.exe' | where FileName != 'w3wp.exe' | where FileName != 'conhost.exe' | where ProcessCommandLine contains 'aspnet' or ProcessCommandLine contains '\\webroot\\'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessCreation EventCode=1 ParentImage=*\\w3wp.exe
tuning: w3wp spawning shells/cmd = webshell execution.

name: PHP webshell access pattern
kql: WebApplicationFirewallLogs | where UrlPath contains 'eval(' or UrlPath contains 'system(' or UrlPath contains 'passthru('
spl: index=web sourcetype=weblog url=*eval(* OR url=*system(* OR url=*passthru(*
tuning: WebshelL keywords in URL/body params; review POST bodies.

name: Automated account creation then immediate logon
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4720, 4730) | let acct = Account | join kind=inner (SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where TimeGenerated between (now(-15m) .. now())) on Account
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4730 | join Account [search index=windows EventCode=4624]
tuning: Account created + logged in within 15 min = attacker backdoor account.

name: Non-admin adds user to Remote Management Users
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4732 | where TargetAccount == 'Remote Management Users' | where SubjectUserName !contains '$'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4732 TargetAccount="Remote Management Users"
tuning: WinRM backdoor prep

name: ADSI/AD module enumeration (recon)
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine contains 'LDAP://' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'Get-ADUser' or ProcessCommandLine contains 'Get-ADComputer'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational EventCode=4104 ScriptBlockText=*Get-ADUser* OR ScriptBlockText=*LDAP://*
tuning: Bulk enumeration in short window by one account.

name: BloodHound-style session enumeration (NetSessionEnum)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5140 or EventID == 5145 | where RelativeTargetName contains 'sessions' or ShareName contains 'IPC$' | where AccountName != ''
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=5140 ShareName=IPC$
tuning: IPC$ bursts from single host = session scanning (BloodHound/SharpHound).

name: Access to sensitive share extensions (pst/dmp/bak)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 5145 | where RelativeTargetName matches regex @'\.(pst|ost|dmp|bak|vhd|vmdk|key|crt)$' | summarize count() by AccountName, Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m) | where count_ >= 10
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=5145 (RelativeTargetName=*.pst OR *.dmp OR *.bak OR *.vhd)
tuning: Backup agents exempt; alert non-backup accounts.

name: SAM dump via vssadmin copy (volsnap)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where ProcessName endswith '\\vssadmin.exe' and CommandLine contains 'copy' and (CommandLine contains '\\System32\\config' or CommandLine contains 'shadow')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessCreation EventCode=1 Image=*\\vssadmin.exe CommandLine=*create* shadow*
tuning: Shadow copy creation + copy of config hive = hashdump precursor.
